items: [Charming Farmhouse Style] Bring the farmhouse charm to your home with this file cabinet. Its unique honey brown color and barn doors are sure to liven up any office, study, or even bedroom as a nightstand!
[2 Roomy File Drawers] 2 spacious file drawers, each with an adjustable hanging rail, accommodate lots of A4 or letter-size file folders, keeping your files shipshape and easy to find

[Smooth, Silent Slides] Quality slides make the 2 drawers of this file cabinet for home offices slide in and out smoothly and quietly, allowing easy access to your files while keeping your space quiet

[Sturdy, Stable, and Durable] This filing cabinet doubles as a reliable printer stand! Crafted with premium, thick particleboard, it can comfortably hold up to 110 lb, providing stable support for your items year after year

[Easy to Assemble] Labeled parts and detailed instructions make the assembly of this office cabinet a breeze. You can proudly nest it in your home office or anywhere you need extra storage and style ASAP!
